body:
## Summary
- prevent complex grenade aiming from starting while `G` is still held during the handoff step
- drop the grenade at the player's feet if `G` is released before the right-hand transfer completes
- keep the GDScript and C# player grenade state machines aligned for the same edge cases
- add a regression test covering the complex grenade throw state machine for issue #1819

## Testing
- `dotnet build GodotTopDownTemplate.sln`
- GUT regression test added in `tests/unit/test_player_grenade_complex_throw.gd` (not run locally because Godot headless CLI was not installed in this workspace)

Fixes #1819
